description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for adding Dynamic DNS (DDNS) entries, including form handling, client-side validation via JavaScript, and server-side includes. It manages user input for Service Provider, User Name, Password, and multiple Host Names, with validation checks and AJAX submission to a backend script.

methods.name: add1
methods.description: Removes dynamically added host name input fields and their associated button elements from the DOM.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates and appends new input fields and a remove button for adding additional Host Name entries dynamically.
